correctness.rationale: Two independent exact enumerators visit all 7-edge matchings of the 15-vertex Petersen line graph (one via hole-recursion, one via all combinations of the 30 edges); they agree on exactly 480. Both adjacency constructions agree on all 960 edges; all-pairs BFS and independent SciPy shortest paths agree on every distance; complete distance-nine C4 decomposition and S5 actions checked; explicit Hamilton 480-cycle certificate verified including closing edge. This finite exhaustive evidence proves only this finite graph.

value.rationale: The foundational matching-graph program motivates exact distance geometry and Hamiltonian traversal of maximum matchings, and these are natural invariants for the highly symmetric Petersen line graph. The precise 120-square distance-nine decomposition is an unexpected structural classification, while an explicit Hamilton cycle gives a Gray-code traversal of all 480 optimal matchings. Neither is a routine derivation of the 480 census, and both provide a reproducible benchmark for strict cardinality-preserving matching reconfiguration.
